standaloneClients.notes: Separate loopback application served by scripts/hermes-office/server.py, not the Next/Firebase website. Exclusion requires an explicit standalone entry and no imports from website source.

/api/ai-config.notes: Admin OpenRouter configuration endpoint routed through the authenticated Hosting API gateway.

/api/ai-config/test.notes: Admin-only OpenRouter diagnostics routed through the Hosting API gateway.

/api/activity-logs.notes: Authenticated client activity writes handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/admin/activity-logs.notes: Admin activity browser endpoint handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/admin/check.notes: Backed by functions/src/api/adminCheck.ts for shared access hooks.

/api/admin/menu-sites.notes: Permission-gated menu management write endpoint handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/admin/image-budgets.notes: Full-admin per-user image policy and manual uncertain accounting; enforced by both image reservation transactions, same-operation replay stays blocked.

/api/production-inbox.notes: Authenticated current-UID read-only production discovery across fixed legacy stores; no paid replay or cross-account reads.

/api/admin/invitations.notes: Full-admin onboarding invitation issuance, bounded listing, cancellation and token rotation; no automatic access grants.

/api/invitations/accept.notes: Verified-email single-use onboarding acceptance; explicit access review required, no claims or userAccess mutation.

/api/admin/users.notes: Admin and userManagement permission endpoint handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/convert-image.notes: Authenticated Sharp image conversion handled by the Functions gateway with size and rate limits.

/api/emoticon-studio/plan.notes: Permission-gated OpenRouter animation planning and model capability metadata handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/extract-video-frame.notes: Video frame extraction requires a Node runtime.

/api/fetch-image.notes: Authenticated SSRF-safe external image proxy handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/generate-image.notes: OpenRouter image generation handled by the Hosting API gateway using Firebase Secret.

/api/generate-image-storyboard.notes: Authenticated OpenRouter storyboard planning handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/generate-image-storyboard/flow.notes: Authenticated OpenRouter storyboard flow redesign handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/generate-image-storyboard/scene.notes: Authenticated OpenRouter single-scene storyboard redesign handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/generate-project-board-content.notes: Permission-gated OpenRouter HTML generation handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/generate-video.notes: Authenticated OpenRouter video generation handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/merge-videos.notes: Video merge endpoint requires ffmpeg-capable server runtime.

/api/openrouter-usage.notes: Admin-only OpenRouter usage, token, and cost reporting endpoint backed by functions/src/api/openRouterUsage.ts.

/api/storyboards/[storyboardId].notes: Authenticated storyboard cascade deletion removes owned media, jobs, clips, project metadata, and storyboard subcollections.

/api/sub-agent/scrape.notes: Route returns 404 in production and should stay hidden from production UI.

/api/user/erp-home-preferences.notes: Signed-in ERP home preference persistence handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/video-studio/clips.notes: Owned Video Studio clip creation handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/video-studio/estimate.notes: Authenticated OpenRouter video model auto-selection and cost estimation handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/video-studio/clips/[clipId].notes: Owned Video Studio clip deletion handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/video-studio/jobs.notes: Owned Video Studio job submission handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/video-studio/jobs/[jobId].notes: Owned Video Studio job requeue and cancel operations handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/video-studio/jobs/process.notes: Authenticated owned-job manual processing endpoint; queued jobs are also handled by triggers.

/api/video-studio/jobs/run.notes: Authenticated alias for owned Video Studio job processing.

/api/video-studio/projects/[projectId]/s.notes: Owned Video Studio residual storage inspection and deletion handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/video-studio/projects/[projectId]/t.notes: Owned Video Studio timeline resequencing handled by the Hosting API gateway.

/api/video-studio/readiness.notes: Authenticated no-charge readiness checks for Firebase Admin, FFmpeg, and automatic OpenRouter video model selection.

/api/video-studio/status.notes: Authenticated Video Studio runtime status handled by the Hosting API gateway.
